$description: MetalUI icons: Soft Hardware monoline + duotone, 24×24 grid, stroke 1.7. Each icon has an authored hover pose and press one-shot.

icons.name: select
icons.label: Select
icons.hover: The pointer draws back, clicks its tip down, and a ring opens where it lands.

motion.caption: The pointer draws back, clicks its tip down, and a ring opens where it lands.

icons.construction: Arrow polygon, 4 vertices, round join; the two outer vertices get 0.5u radius arcs. Motion (study): the pointer draws back 1.5 down-right, darts onto its tip and squashes .86 along its length; the click ring opens at the tip after contact and widens as it fades.

icons.name: text
icons.label: Text
icons.hover: glyph steps aside, caret appears and blinks
icons.construction: T with soft 1.2u corner drops; caret is a separate 6.2u line.

icons.name: note
icons.label: Note
icons.hover: corner curls up
icons.construction: Rounded square r3.5 with a diagonal corner cut; curl = animatable cut size c (5.3 rest, 7.2 hover). SwiftUI Shape with animatableData = c.

icons.name: image
icons.label: Image
icons.hover: sun rises behind the ridge
icons.construction: Landscape keyline. Sun is masked by the ridge (fill + 1u gap), so it can rise from behind it.

icons.name: link
icons.label: Link
icons.hover: links pull apart, bar thins
icons.construction: Two open capsule halves on the 45° axis, radius 3.7, plus a bridging bar. Separation is one animatable scalar.

icons.name: draw
icons.label: Draw
icons.hover: tip slides and draws a stroke
icons.construction: Pencil built upright (body w4.6, eraser band at y8) then rotated 45°. Stroke is revealed by trim in sync with the pencil travelling on the same curve.

icons.name: pen
icons.label: Pen
icons.hover: the nib glides and lays a wave of ink
icons.press: the nib presses: the line swells and a drop of ink blooms
icons.construction: A fountain nib on the Draw pencil frame (same length, angle and tip point): shoulders 6.4 wide, a slit from the tip to the breather hole. Hover glides the nib along a small wave and the ink follows its tip on the same spring. Press is pressure: the nib squashes toward the page, the line swells to 2.7, and a drop of ink blooms at the tip and soaks in.

icons.name: marker
icons.label: Marker
icons.hover: it sweeps right and lays a see-through band
icons.press: it lifts back, then sweeps a fresh band
icons.construction: A marker on the Draw pencil frame: the same 5.2 barrel, ending in a slanted chisel tip. The band (duo .26, sits under the words) is always as long as the tip has travelled: hover and press move them on the same curve. Press lifts the marker back to the start while the old band fades, then it leans into the page and sweeps a fresh one.

icons.name: line
icons.label: Line
icons.hover: The end handle is picked up and dragged back, the pen presses the start, and the line is drawn out to snap onto its end.

motion.caption: The end handle is picked up and dragged back, the pen presses the start, and the line is drawn out to snap onto its end.

icons.construction: One diagonal corner to corner (5.4 to 18.6), a cubic with its handles on the line, and a 1.3 dot at each end. Motion (study): the end dot is picked up (1.35) and dragged back to .38 of the length, the stroke retracting with it; the start dot is pressed (.72); the drag draws the stroke out, carries 9% past the end (the stroke stretched from its start), and the handle drops onto its point with a snap ring.

icons.name: arrow
icons.label: Arrow
icons.hover: The arrow is drawn back from its held tail and thrust at its mark; the head strikes, compresses into its tip, and rebounds.

motion.caption: The arrow is drawn back from its held tail and thrust at its mark; the head strikes, compresses into its tip, and rebounds.

icons.construction: A corner-to-corner shaft (5.4,18.6 to 18,6; a cubic, straight) with an open right-angle head (7.8 legs) whose tip is 18.6,5.4, the same span as Line. Motion (study): the head draws back 2 along the line and is thrust into its mark, driving .3 past and compressing .8 into its tip; the shaft is scaled from its fixed tail by the same travel so it stays joined; three short rays open beyond the tip; it rebounds .7 and settles.

icons.name: rectangle
icons.label: Rectangle
icons.hover: A handle grabs the far corner and drags the box in toward its pinned corner, then out past its size; let go, it springs back.

motion.caption: A handle grabs the far corner and drags the box in toward its pinned corner, then out past its size; let go, it springs back.

icons.construction: A 17.2 × 14 rounded box (r3.2), open, drawn as eight pieces (four corner arcs, four straight sides) that join into the same contour. Motion (study): a handle appears on the bottom-right corner and drags the box in to 9 × 8 toward its pinned top-left corner, then out .9 past its size; the far corners translate with the drag and the sides stretch only along their length, so the corners stay round and the stroke keeps its width. Let go, the handle drops, a ring opens at the corner and the box springs back.

icons.name: ellipse
icons.label: Ellipse
icons.hover: A pen comes down on the ellipse and draws it again all the way round; the loop closes where it began.

motion.caption: A pen comes down on the ellipse and draws it again all the way round; the loop closes where it began.

icons.construction: An 8.6 × 6.9 ellipse, open, as wide as the Image frame, with a second copy on top that draws. Motion (study): a pen point comes down on the rightmost point and travels clockwise once round (16 steps, eased in and out), the new stroke drawn behind it by arc length while the old outline dims to a .22 guide; at the join a ring opens, the outline comes back up and the pen lifts away.

icons.name: eraser
icons.label: Eraser
icons.hover: The eraser is pressed onto a scribble and rubbed left, right and left; the scribble goes a pass at a time and crumbs flick away.

motion.caption: The eraser is pressed onto a scribble and rubbed left, right and left; the scribble goes a pass at a time and crumbs flick away.

icons.construction: An eraser on the Draw pencil frame, a little wider (6.4) with round ends and one band line between sleeve and rubber; its flat rubber end faces down-left, lowest corner at 7.2,19.9. Motion (study): a scribble fades in under it; the eraser lifts, presses down (.9 along the push) and rubs left, right, left about its lowest corner, leaning 7° into each pass; the scribble is taken away a third per pass, two crumbs flick out and fall, and it springs up off the page back to rest.

icons.name: layout
icons.label: Layout
icons.hover: The panes are drawn apart, snap back onto the grid, and the gutter rule flashes where they seat.

motion.caption: The panes are drawn apart, snap back onto the grid, and the gutter rule flashes where they seat.

icons.construction: One tall + two square tiles, radius 2.4, 2.8u gutter. Motion (study): the columns are drawn apart (tall 1.1 left, squares 1.3 right), snap back onto the gutter squashing .84 against it in order tall, top, bottom, and spring out of the squash on the object spring; a gutter rule flashes at the seam.

icons.name: tidy
icons.label: Tidy
icons.hover: The loose pills are knocked square against the guide, and registration ticks flash where they sit flush.

motion.caption: The loose pills are knocked square against the guide, and registration ticks flash where they sit flush.

icons.construction: Guide + three pills (h4, r2), loose at rest (≤5°, a rest transform on each rect). Motion (study): the pills draw back .7, then are knocked flush and square against the guide in order (squash .86 along their length, part spring), the guide gives .6 under the knock; registration ticks flash between guide and pills; held square, they relax back to loose.

icons.name: search
icons.label: Search
icons.hover: The lens is swept across the field and stops; the focus closes in and a glint crosses the glass.

motion.caption: The lens is swept across the field and stops; the focus closes in and a glint crosses the glass.

icons.construction: Circle keyline lens r6.3; handle 45°. Motion (study): the tool turns about its grip (19.8, 19.8): drawn back 6°, swept to -10.5° and caught at -7° with one rebound; a focus ring closes from r4.2 onto a r2 subject and a glint arc (r3.4) crosses the glass; swung home with a light overshoot.

icons.name: zoom-in
icons.label: Zoom In
icons.hover: The lens is pushed in along its handle and the plus under it is magnified.

motion.caption: The lens is pushed in along its handle and the plus under it is magnified.

icons.construction: Search lens + plus (4.8u arms), the plus always upright: turned, it passes through ×, "clear". Motion (study): the tool draws back .6 down its handle axis, is pushed in 1.2 up it and stopped with a small rebound; the plus, a beat behind, is magnified to 1.3 (part spring); four diagonal marks are thrown outward between the arms; released, all slide home.

icons.name: zoom-out
icons.label: Zoom Out
icons.hover: The lens is drawn back along its handle; the minus recedes and the old view closes in.

motion.caption: The lens is drawn back along its handle; the minus recedes and the old view closes in.

icons.construction: Search lens + minus. Motion (study): the tool eases in .5 up its handle axis, is pulled back 1.3 down it and caught at 1.1 (part spring); the minus, a beat behind, recedes to .7; the corners of the old view appear at the rim and close in as they fade; released, all slide home.

icons.name: fit
icons.label: Fit
icons.hover: The content grows to the frame and the four corners clamp onto it; the open sides of the frame flash shut.

motion.caption: The content grows to the frame and the four corners clamp onto it; the open sides of the frame flash shut.

icons.construction: Four r2.6 corner brackets on the square keyline + 6u rounded square. Motion (study): the corners open .5 while the content draws in, then the content grows to 1.42 and the corners clamp in 1.3 along their diagonals and seat at 1.0 (the content gives to 1.35 and recovers); seams flash in the frame's open sides between them; the corners let go on the release spring and the content settles back.

icons.name: duplicate
icons.label: Duplicate
icons.hover: copy slides off the original
icons.construction: Two 12u squares r3, offset 5u; the back one is masked by the front + 1.5u gap (so no outline crosses the copy).

icons.name: send-away
icons.label: Delete · Send away
icons.hover: well turns, dot is drawn in
icons.press: dot is pulled into the centre and vanishes
icons.construction: Archimedean spiral r = 1.05→8.5 over 1.62 turns, clockwise, outer end at −50°. Dot r1.4 at 38° ahead of the end on r8.35. Native: Shape with animatable phase; dot position is polar (θ, r).

icons.name: trash
icons.label: Delete · Trash
icons.hover: lid lifts on its hinge
icons.press: lid closes with a small settle
icons.construction: Portrait keyline bin, tapered 0.9u each side, lid hinged at the left end.

icons.name: group
icons.label: Group · Stack
icons.hover: cards rise and fan above the flap
icons.construction: Folder back (tab left) knocked out around two fanned cards (−8° / +5°); the front card knocks out the back card; both clipped 1u above the flap. Frosted flap = duotone 16%. Mirrors the Softness Folder component.

icons.name: ungroup
icons.label: Ungroup
icons.hover: cards spread wider
icons.construction: Open tray (flap only) with two cards lifted out, ±6° at rest.

icons.name: pin
icons.label: Pin
icons.hover: pin lifts, its contact shadow fades
icons.construction: Pushpin: 5.2u cap, collar, flared base, needle. Contact line under the needle.

icons.name: board
icons.label: Board
icons.hover: ribbon lengthens
icons.construction: Portrait ribbon, notch depth animatable (3.0 → 3.4) with the tail length.

icons.name: share
icons.label: Share · Export
icons.hover: arrow lifts out of the tray
icons.press: arrow leaves, a new one rises
icons.construction: Open tray (r2.4) with a 10u arrow.

icons.name: undo
icons.label: Undo
icons.hover: head reaches back
icons.construction: Hook arrow, arc r4.6. Rotation pivot = arc centre (14.6, 13.6).

icons.name: redo
icons.label: Redo
icons.hover: head reaches forward
icons.construction: Undo mirrored on x.

icons.name: more
icons.label: More
icons.hover: a wave runs through the dots, left to right: it goes on
icons.construction: Three r1.55 dots on 6.4u pitch. An ellipsis means it continues, so hover is a wave, not a swell: each dot rises 1.2 and swells 1.15 in turn, 70 ms apart, left to right, once. The wave is on a wrapper per dot so the press (the outer dots gather to the centre and part: the menu opens from one point) still plays while hovered.

icons.name: close
icons.label: Close
icons.hover: its arms draw in toward the crossing, ready
icons.press: it folds into its centre and springs back out
icons.construction: X on the circle keyline, arms 13.6u, always at 45°: a turn is no motion for an ×, it reads as loading. Hover draws both arms in toward the crossing (.86), a surface poised to fold up. Press folds it into its centre (.42) and springs it back out past the hover pose; the thing it closes goes the same way.

icons.name: check
icons.label: Check
icons.hover: it nods yes about its vertex
icons.press: the tick is drawn again and lands with weight
icons.construction: Tick 4.1 / 9.1 legs about the vertex (9.5, 16.7). Hover is a single nod, yes: it dips 7° about the vertex, rises 3° past rest and settles (a one-shot, agreeing is an act). Press draws it again from the short leg and it lands heavier (2.1) where the stroke finishes, then eases back. The nod is on a wrapper so a press while hovered still draws.

icons.name: synced
icons.label: Synced
icons.hover: satellite advances along its orbit
icons.construction: Core r2.1, orbit r7.6 with a 63° gap centred on the satellite (r1.75, 12 o’clock). Native: rotate the orbit group; SF Symbol can use .symbolEffect(.rotate) on macOS 15+ or a custom rotation.

icons.name: offline
icons.label: Offline
icons.hover: satellite drifts further out
icons.construction: Same orbit, 94° gap; satellite has left the ring (r≈9.6).

icons.name: sync-error
icons.label: Sync Error
icons.hover: the orbit tries to turn, catches and snaps back; the mark jumps
icons.construction: Orbit with the same gap as Synced, core replaced by "!". Hover is Synced's own motion failing: the orbit starts to turn (18°, easing in, trying), catches and snaps back past rest, and the mark jumps as it catches. A one-shot on its own wrapper, so the press (the orbit shivers once) still plays while hovered.

icons.name: capture
icons.label: Capture
icons.hover: viewfinder focuses in
icons.construction: Four r3.2 corners (softer than Fit) + aperture circle r3.6.

icons.name: paste
icons.label: Paste
icons.hover: clip lifts
icons.construction: Portrait clipboard r2.4, clip r1.3, two content lines.

icons.name: keeper
icons.label: Keeper
icons.hover: blinks
icons.construction: The buddy as a glyph: solid body r6.8 with eye capsules knocked out (2.4×4.2), accretion ring rx9.8 ry2.5 tilted −12°; the front arc knocks a 1.1u gap into the body, the back arc hides behind it.

icons.name: plus
icons.label: New
icons.hover: the plus grows out from the centre of the tile
icons.press: the tile presses in and the plus pops out, made
icons.construction: Tile 15 × 15 r3.5, tinted .12; plus arms 6.4 on the centre, always upright: at 45° a plus is the close glyph, so it never turns. Hover grows the arms out from the centre to 7.8 (the path, so the stroke keeps its weight), the new thing about to be made. Press squeezes the tile (.92) and the plus with it (5.8), then as the tile comes back the plus pops to 8.6 and settles: made.

icons.name: region
icons.label: Region
icons.hover: The frame is set down on the canvas, and its name writes into the head behind a caret.

motion.caption: The frame is set down on the canvas, and its name writes into the head behind a caret.

icons.construction: Frame 17 × 14 r3.5, tinted .08; head rule on the 9.6 line; the name a 3.6 wire in the head. Motion (study): the frame lifts 1.4 and lands on its bottom edge (squash .92, object spring) while the name erases, then the name writes back in behind a caret that blinks once at its end.

icons.name: task
icons.label: Task
icons.hover: the tick nods yes inside its box
icons.press: the box presses in and comes back up ticked
icons.construction: Dimple 14 × 14 r3.5, tinted .12, with the check tick at the size of the box. Hover is the check nod, a little smaller, about the tick's vertex. Press is completion by the item itself: the box presses in (.94) like a physical checkbox, and the tick draws in once the press has bottomed out (80 ms), the result of the press.

icons.name: tag
icons.label: Tag
icons.hover: The cord tugs the tag by its eyelet, and it swings there and comes to hang still.

motion.caption: The cord tugs the tag by its eyelet, and it swings there and comes to hang still.

icons.construction: Tag 15.4 × 14 with a rounded point, tinted .12; eyelet bead 2.6 on the centre line. Motion (study): the cord tugs the tag 1.2 left by its eyelet, then it whips to 14° about the eyelet and swings out (−6°, +2.5°, −0.8°); a ring opens at the eyelet when the cord goes taut.

icons.name: calendar
icons.label: Calendar
icons.hover: Today's leaf curls up and flips over the binding, kicking the rings, and a fresh page is left.

motion.caption: Today's leaf curls up and flips over the binding, kicking the rings, and a fresh page is left.

icons.construction: Page 17 × 15 r3.2, tinted .08; header rule on the 10 line; binding rings at the 8 and 16 detents. Motion (study): today's leaf (an accent the shape of the page below the rule) curls from its bottom edge and flips up about the header rule; passing the binding it kicks the rings 1.4 up, which drop back on the part spring; the leaf lies over the head and fades.

icons.name: document
icons.label: Document
icons.hover: A thumb folds the corner down, the page turns, and the next page's lines write in.

motion.caption: A thumb folds the corner down, the page turns, and the next page's lines write in.

icons.construction: Page 13.4 × 17 with a 5-unit cut corner, tinted .1; lines 6.8 and 4 on the 12.4 and 15.8 lines. Motion (study): a corner flap (accent, tinted .2) folds about the cut diagonal onto the page, holds the crease, flicks back out past the edge and lies flat; meanwhile the lines erase and write back in, first then second: the page has turned.

icons.name: clock
icons.label: Time
icons.hover: An hour passes: the minute hand sweeps round as the hour hand steps one on, a tick marks the hour, and the hands are set back.

motion.caption: An hour passes: the minute hand sweeps round as the hour hand steps one on, a tick marks the hour, and the hands are set back.

icons.construction: Face r8.5, tinted .08; two hands about the centre, minute 4.6 (up) and hour 3.8, so the face always shows a time a clock can show. Motion (study): hands geared 12 : 1 on one timeline: a 10° take-up, the minute hand sweeps a full turn (hour one hour on) into a detent overshoot, a tick flashes at 12 on the hour, then both are set back to rest.

icons.name: me
icons.label: Me
icons.hover: Today's point runs back along your days and climbs to today again, drawing the trend behind it.

motion.caption: Today's point runs back along your days and climbs to today again, drawing the trend behind it.

icons.construction: Screen 16 × 16 r3.5, tinted .08; trend of three segments ending in a 2.4 bead. Motion (study): the bead runs back down the trend to its first day, erasing it, then climbs again drawing it (the bead is always the drawn tip), is flung .7 past today along the last rise and pulled back; a ring opens at today.

icons.name: seed
icons.label: Seed sample
icons.hover: The seed is dropped in and lands on its bottom; the sprout takes the blow, springs up, and its leaf swings.

motion.caption: The seed is dropped in and lands on its bottom; the sprout takes the blow, springs up, and its leaf swings.

icons.construction: Seed 11.2 × 13.2, tinted .14; sprout stem 2.6 and a tinted leaf from its top. Motion (study): the seed lifts 1.6 and lands on its bottom (squash .9, object spring); the sprout lags, sinks .5 into it and springs .7 past rest; the leaf flops 18° about its joint and swings back; two puffs of soil spread along the ground at its base.
